第一卷 第645章 请问你收容辞的理由是什么（第1页）
她心底情绪翻涌，但她很快就让自己镇定了下来。
听到有人插话进来，她顿了下，看向来人。
来人见陆博士不高兴了，赶紧赔笑：“抱歉陆博士，我只是有些好奇，打扰了您跟人聊天的兴致，非常抱歉。”
来者是客，陆博士虽然不认识对方，但到底不好继续跟人计较，说道：“没关系。”
话落，看到周围的人都看了过来，知道大家是好奇他是不是要收容辞做自己的亲传学生。
他笑了笑，视线落在了容辞深入，随后又看向了大家，然后，和他助手一起走上了舞台。
他笑看着众人，说道：“非常感谢诸位前来参加陆某研究院的周年庆，对于收亲传学生一事，我本来想晚点再上台正式当着众人的面询问容小姐的，现在既然大家已经提前知晓，那我也就请大家现在给我做一下见证。”
说完，他看向了容辞，说道：“容小姐，我现在称呼你一声容小姐，但我更希望有机会能称呼你为小辞，因为我发现你的朋友都是这样称呼你的。小辞，我确实有意想收你成为我的学生，不知你是否愿意认我这个老师？”
大家都觉得容辞能有今天的成就，离不开郁默勋的帮助和支持，其中，南致知估计也没少提点过她。
但南致知似乎并没有收她做自己的学生。
不过，就算南致知没有收她做自己的学生，以她和郁默勋的关系，南致知日后估计也能在专业上提点她。
所以，容辞要是继续留在长墨，对她来说，已经是一个别人看来不管想象的好出路。
但陆博士手下出色的学生众多，有好几位名气都不低，在业界地位和累积的财富有人甚至比郁默勋还高，比他成名也早。
更何况，陆博士在国内外都拥有非常身后的人脉。
陆博士对容辞来说，也确实是一个极好的选择。
而林家和孙家人，还有连凝绮，任戟风等人，看着眼前这一幕，看着陆博士这么礼遇和重视容辞的模样，孙莉瑶和连凝绮气得眼睛都红了，咬牙切齿地看向容辞之后，也心疼地看向林芜。
孙月清也看着台上的陆博士，但她也只能默默地看着，不过，红唇抿得很紧。

林立海看着，看向了容辞，心情有几分复杂。
他虽然有注意到陆博士好像很喜欢容辞，但他没想到陆博士居然会大张旗鼓的当着众人的面收他为自己的学生。
林芜站在封庭深身边，看着这一切，握着酒杯的手用力到发白，且只要认真看，就会发现她攥着酒杯的手无法控制地微微发抖。
但她也只能尽量维持表面体面地看着眼前这一切。
不管众人心思如何，有人看向陆博士，大部分人却看向了容辞，都等着她的回答，没有人注意到，在明确陆博士要上台公布要收容辞当自己学生时，有人也缓缓地跟着挪到了舞台附近。
在大家都等着容辞开口时，他冷笑了声，忽然走上了舞台：“陆博士，请问你要收容辞当你学生的理由，是什么？”

Volume 1 Chapter 645 What is the reason for your admission statement (Page 1)
Her heart was filled with emotions, but she quickly calmed herself down.
When she heard someone interrupt, she paused and looked at the person.
When the visitor saw that Dr. Lu was unhappy, he quickly apologized and said, "I'm sorry, Dr. Lu. I'm just curious and disturbed your interest in chatting with others. I'm very sorry."
The visitor was a guest. Although Dr. Lu didn't know the other person, he couldn't continue to argue with him and said, "It doesn't matter."
After he finished speaking, he saw everyone around him looking over, knowing that everyone was curious about whether he wanted to take Rong Ci as his direct student.
He smiled, his eyes fell on Rong Ci, then looked at everyone, and then walked onto the stage with his assistant.
He looked at everyone with a smile and said: "Thank you very much for coming to participate in the anniversary celebration of Lu Institute. As for the admission of direct students, I originally wanted to go on stage to formally ask Miss Rong in front of everyone later. Now that everyone has known about it in advance, I will ask everyone to testify for me now."
After speaking, he looked at Rong Ci and said: "Miss Rong, I will call you Miss Rong now, but I would rather have the opportunity to call you Xiao Ci, because I found that your friends all call you this. Xiao Ci, I do want to accept you as my student. I wonder if you are willing to recognize me as your teacher?"
Everyone feels that Rong Ci's achievements today are inseparable from Yu Moxun's help and support. Among them, Nan Zhizhi probably mentioned her a lot.
But Nan Zhizhi didn't seem to accept her as his student.
However, even if Nan Zhizhi did not accept her as his student, given her relationship with Yu Moxun, Nan Zhizhi would probably be able to give her some professional guidance in the future.
Therefore, if Rong Ci continues to stay in Changmo, it is already a good way out for her, no matter what others think.
However, Dr. Lu has many outstanding students, and several of them are quite famous. Some even have higher status and accumulated wealth in the industry than Yu Moxun, and they became famous earlier than him.
What's more, Dr. Lu has a lot of connections at home and abroad.
Dr. Lu is indeed an excellent choice for Rong Ci.
The Lin and Sun families, as well as Lian Ningqi, Ren Jifeng and others, looked at the scene in front of them and saw Dr. Lu treating Rong Ci with such courtesy and attention. Sun Liyao and Lian Ningqi's eyes were red with anger. After looking at Rong Ci with gritted teeth, they also looked at Lin Wu with distress.
Sun Yueqing also looked at Dr. Lu on the stage, but she could only watch silently, but her red lips were pursed tightly.
Lin Lihai looked at Rong Ci with a somewhat complicated mood.
Although he noticed that Dr. Lu seemed to like Rong Ci very much, he did not expect that Dr. Lu would accept him as his student in front of everyone with great fanfare.
Lin Wu stood next to Feng Tingshen, watching all this. The hand holding the wine glass was so hard that it turned white. If you look carefully, you will find that her hand holding the wine glass was shaking slightly uncontrollably.
But she could only try her best to look at everything in front of her with dignity.
No matter what everyone's thoughts were, some people looked at Dr. Lu, but most people looked at Rong Ci, waiting for her answer. No one noticed that when it became clear that Dr. Lu was going to go on stage to announce that he would take Rong Ci as his student, some people slowly moved closer to the stage.
When everyone was waiting for Rong Ci to speak, he sneered and suddenly walked onto the stage: "Dr. Lu, may I ask why you want Rong Ci to be your student?"
